svg.title: A restore reached warm in 4.60 to 4.72 s; a cold boot in 28.99 to 30.91 s
svg.desc: Three groups of bars against one axis, seconds, from boot 9's snapshots, taken with the cell's containers frozen and the drive's cache_type Unsafe, io_engine Sync. The top group is the three cold boots, K1 to K3, each from the VM's start, as cells/rootfs/snapshot.sh printed them, a bar of four segments, left to right: boot to ssh, then dockerd ready, then compose up, then the warm checks to HealthCheck done; compose up starts at dockerd ready, so a bar's end is dockerd ready plus compose up to HealthCheck done. Each one's copy of the image ran before its start, and after warm it froze its 11 containers in 0.29 to 0.31 s and took its snapshot in 33.63 to 33.92 s, none of them drawn. The middle group is R1's 12 restores of K3's snapshot, each from snapshot/load, as cells/rootfs/restore.sh printed them: a bar of four segments: snapshot/load and ssh, the guest clock read, set and read again, to the thaw's start, the thaw of the 11 containers, 1.18 to 1.32 s, the warm checks; each restore's reflink copy of the golden disk, 0.01 to 0.02 s, ran before it. Beside each: the guest clock behind the host before the set, 35.2 to 94.5 s, and its offset after it. The bottom group is the golden disk, 5.04 GiB allocated of 16 GiB, copied plainly after a cache drop, three times, and as a reflink on the same XFS volume, three times, a bar of one segment each, by each step's own stamps. Each time is the step file's; readings.json's entry of each agrees. Sources: docs/tables/fig-restore-timing.jsonl, docs/tables/readings-2026-10-29-boot9.jsonl, docs/tables/src/hosts.tsv.
